prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080. Composition must be SQUARE, never wide or landscape.

CRITICAL — READ FIRST: (a) the drawing must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES with NO frame, NO border line, NO box and NO white margin band; (b) there must be NO starburst, no radiating burst, no sparkle rays and no sunbeam rays anywhere in the picture; (c) use a ZOOMED-IN composition where the main character and the background props all run past every edge of the square, running diagonally across the frame, so nothing floats in empty white space.

SCENE: A cheerful cartoon CELL MEMBRANE character is the friendly gatekeeper wall of a cell, drawn as one long wavy ribbon-wall stretching diagonally from one corner of the picture to the opposite corner, filling almost the whole frame.
- The MEMBRANE CHARACTER'S edge is made of a single tidy row of round bead shapes like a string of big pearls (the phospholipid heads), each bead touching the next, running the whole diagonal length of the character and continuing off both ends of the picture.
- In the middle of the ribbon-wall, draw one big round happy face: two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful eyebrows, and a wide open cheerful grin.
- Cut into the character's body is one big round OPEN GATE / DOORWAY (a simple thick-outlined circle opening straight through the ribbon), with a friendly little round GATEKEEPER-DOOR CHARACTER standing just inside it like a turnstile, two small stubby arms held out to check badges.
- A tiny round MOLECULE CHARACTER with a simple happy face is walking through the open gate from one side to the other, one stubby foot stepping through.
- On top of the ribbon-wall, near the face, draw two or three small flag-shaped ID-BADGE shapes on short stalks, each flag a simple rounded pennant, standing up proudly like little flags planted on the character's back — these are its identification badges.
- Along the same edge as the badges (the outside), add a few short simple curly-line squiggles between the badges, like loose party streamers, to suggest a soft fringe.
- The OTHER long edge of the ribbon-wall (the inside) is kept plain and bare — no flags, no squiggles there, just the row of round beads.
- BACKGROUND, filling the rest of the picture and running off the edges: two or three small round NUTRIENT-CRUMB characters with simple happy faces queued near the open gate, partly cut off by the image edge, waiting their turn to go through; a loose scatter of small plain circles and tiny dots drifting in the open space on both sides of the wall to suggest the busy watery world around the cell.
- Everything is drawn LARGE, SIMPLE and CHUNKY, with generous open white areas inside every shape so a child can colour them in.

STYLE — coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with plenty of white space.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN — the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion rays or halo of rays behind, around or under any character or the open gate. NO radiating lines of any kind anywhere. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, shelf, table, counter or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind. Do NOT draw a thin black line anywhere near the edge of the image. There must be NO white margin between the artwork and the image edge.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES of the square — the ribbon-wall itself runs off two opposite corners, and the background nutrient-crumb friends are CUT OFF by the image edge.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO ID-badge flags or fringe squiggles on the inside/plain edge of the wall — they belong only on the outside edge.
- NO human figures, no real flames, no arrows.
